name: Agent identity
note: Its own name, handle, avatar, phone and inbox
summary: The agent gets its own email address or phone number instead of acting through the user's. It can sign up, receive codes and correspond under its own identity, and the user's inbox stays out of reach.
how: Provision an inbox or number for the agent through an API
Agent sends and receives through webhooks
Use it for sign-ups, verification codes and outreach
facts: AgentMail (inbox API, free tier of 3 inboxes / 3,000 emails a month)
Separates identities, but services may treat agent accounts as bots
goodFor: Agents that need to receive verification codes
Keeping the user's personal inbox private
watchOut: Incoming mail is untrusted input (prompt injection)
Sites' terms may forbid automated accounts
